Change 'credit[msg.sender]=0;' to 'credit[msg.sender]=1;' so the credit is set to 1 instead of 0 after withdrawal.
Delete the entire 'if' block (lines with balance update, call, require, and credit reset) so that nothing happens when oCredit > 0.
Change 'if (oCredit>0)' to 'if (oCredit>=0)' so that the block executes even when oCredit is zero.
